name: ai-model-selector
title: AI Model Selector
description: A pill in an AI composer showing the current model and effort. Pressing it opens a panel above with a radio list of models and a segmented effort track whose stops change with the chosen model, plus a line explaining the trade-off.
use: An AI composer needs one compact control for both the model and how hard it should think.
avoid: The panel is 320px wide and opens upward, so it needs room above; models and effort levels come from you.
a11y: Everything works from the keyboard and is labelled; the track's stop labels are hidden from screen readers, so its value text carries the meaning. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rounded composer card with a line of prompt text, a small pill showing the model name, a tiny signal-bar glyph and an effort word, and paperclip and send circles beside it. The open panel above is a white rounded card with model rows and a segmented effort track.
behaves: Clicking the pill opens the panel upward with a spring; picking a model checks it and reshapes the effort stops, keeping a similar relative height. The track can be dragged, clicked or arrowed, and the hint below swaps as the level changes.
customise: Pass a models array with names, descriptions, icons and effort levels plus controlled value and onChange; the panel styling, spring and effort carry-over need a source edit.
weight: light: A small pill and a panel of a few rows; animation runs only while opening or dragging.
